title: Oak Ridge visit arranged by Howard Baker

tellings.quote: I went to go up to Oak Ridge and spend some time with them

plain: Sometime between the 1970s and the 1980s, a senior government adviser says he was sent to spend time at Oak Ridge, the US government nuclear research laboratory in Tennessee, on a visit arranged through Howard Baker, a senator from Tennessee. The adviser is Harald Malmgren, who worked as an adviser to presidents and says he handled UFO material directly, and he tells Michels he went himself: "I went to go up to Oak Ridge and spend some time with them." He brings it up as part of how he came close to the government's handling of unexplained material.
